title: Two Epsilon Publishing Group Titles Selected for IBBY Mexico's 2025–2026 Recommended Books Guide
excerpt: Two books published by Epsilon Publishing Group and now read in Mexico have been included in IBBY Mexico's Guía de libros recomendados 2025–2026.
image_alt: IBBY Mexico Guía de libros recomendados 2025–2026
body:
Another milestone in the international journey of Turkish children's literature.

Two titles published by Epsilon Publishing Group, which have reached Mexican readers through the group's international rights work, have been included in \*Guía de libros recomendados 2025–2026\* (Recommended Books Guide 2025–2026), compiled by IBBY Mexico.

Known for its work to promote a culture of reading in children's and young adult literature, IBBY Mexico publishes its guide every year, offering families, educators, librarians and publishing professionals a selection of quality reading recommendations.

For Epsilon Publishing Group, the selection reflects its aim of bringing the work of Turkish authors to readers in other languages and cultures.

With nine publishing imprints, a list of more than 3,000 titles and its international rights work, Epsilon Publishing Group continues to raise the visibility of Turkish literature in world publishing.

Epsilon Publishing Group continues to carry stories that touch children's lives beyond borders.
source: Source: IBBY Mexico, Guía de libros recomendados 2025–2026
